title: Cocartesian lifts of base equivalences are equivalences
statement: Use quasicategories and equivalence edges of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations and cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and isofibrations of [lem-coef-infinity-isofibration-exponentiation]. Work in fixed sufficiently large universes. Let $E,B$ be small quasicategories and $p:E\to B$ an inner fibration. If $u:x\to y$ is a $p$-cocartesian edge and $p(u)$ is an equivalence in $B$, then $u$ is an equivalence in $E$. Consequently every cocartesian fibration between quasicategories is an isofibration: every equivalence $p(x)\to b$ has an equivalence lift with source $x$. No existence of other cocartesian lifts is required for the first assertion.
